serverOnly: This command only works in a server.
manage: Manage names, roles and on/off on the website:
cantCreate: ⚠️ Pingway can't create sheets right now. Please try again later.
whoCanSee: Who can see it? Pick a role
whichRole: ➕ **{name}**: which role can see this sheet in /{command}? (Admins always see every sheet.)
ready: ✅ **{name}** is ready{who}. Anyone with the link can edit it.
layoutWarning: ⚠️ Please don't change the layout of the raid sheet (columns, rows, headers), or Pingway can't read the schedule.
tooMany: This server already has {max} sheets. Remove one first.
freeLimit: This server already has {free} sheets switched on (the free limit). Switch one off on the website, or turn on Supporter Perks for up to {max}.

cmd.logger: ⚙️ Logger sheets: open one or create one (admins only).
cmd.raid: 📅 Raid sheets: open one, check the schedule, or create one (admins).
